description: List MOBILE devices available to the project — union of the LOCAL roster (real devices + emulators/simulators registered via the desktop agent, from `/tm/mobileDevices/search`) and the CLOUD roster (whichever farm the project has integrated: LambdaTest / BrowserStack / SauceLabs / SimplifyQA Device Farm — the first non-empty one wins, matching the UI's single-provider-per-project model). Use before `tc_run` for an ANDROID or IOS test case to pick a `deviceId` (and read `deviceType` + `cloudDeviceType` off the same row). The `active` flag on local rows is last-known: stale by design (the SQA backend writes it when the desktop agent connects/disconnects, and a 7s-stale cron flips it back); a device the user just plugged in may still read `active:false` here. Cloud rows don't carry `active` — cloud farms are always assumed reachable. Requires a live connection.
